claims: Reuters article published 2026-11-01 06:49 UTC reports Binance's status page shortly after 06:00 GMT said planned withdrawals had begun; first phase covers 15 cryptoassets including BTC, ETH, XRP and DOGE.
Reuters reports Binance says it bought approximately $6B of stolen cryptocurrencies as replacement tokens using company funds; remaining 5% are less-liquid assets.

Reuters reports Binance named SAFU including a bitcoin reserve, Futures Insurance Fund and corporate treasury as funding sources; co-CEO Yi He said 50% of SAFU funds would be used while the fund would be replenished toward $1B.
The Reuters report confirms BTC withdrawals resumed; it does not document a successful XRP withdrawal or disclose XRP-specific acquisition quantity, venue or timing.

feature_admission.reason: The Reuters report concerns aggregate exchange recovery and phased availability; no XRP-specific withdrawal or acquisition is verified.

correction_reason: Append the Reuters 06:49 UTC phase-one start report and aggregate replacement-capital details under the existing Reuters source ID; do not create a duplicate source record or infer XRP-specific demand.
